{"action": "sql", "sql": "WITH max_year AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MAX(ordered_on))::int AS yr FROM sales.orders
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_pct / 100) AS net_amount
  FROM sales.orders o
  JOIN sales.order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.ordered_on)::int = (SELECT yr - 1 FROM max_year)
)
SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_sales FROM filtered;"}

  JOIN sales.order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
